title: Fixes

Anyways, I will probably be working on a hobbies page next to document my hobbies :3

title: First Blog Post
text: I have always wanted to make my own personal website. Now that I have a solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I can finally make it. I knew I wanted something cutesy, so before making this website, I made a few sketches of what I wanted it to look like. In this website I will be keeping a blog that is sort of more like a journal, and a few other pages that I will be adding as I go along. Click around to explore!
